title: IPCC AR6: human-caused radiative forcing in 2019 was 2.72 W/m²
summary: Statement A.4.1 gives 2.72 watts per square meter in 2019 relative to 1750, with a range of 1.96 to 3.48, mainly from greenhouse gases and partly offset by aerosols.
body: IPCC Working Group I statement A.4.1 says human-caused radiative forcing of 2.72 watts per square meter, with a range from 1.96 to 3.48, in 2019 relative to 1750, has warmed the climate system. It says this warming is mainly due to increased greenhouse-gas concentrations, partly reduced by cooling from increased aerosol concentrations. It says the forcing increased by 0.43 watts per square meter, 19 percent, relative to the previous assessment, of which 0.34 watts per square meter is from the greenhouse-gas increase since 2011. The bracket is the summary's range, not a second central estimate.
